name: MailFlow-backend
description: API service for MailFlow, a self-hosted webmail client for existing IMAP/SMTP accounts. Install with MailFlow-frontend. PostgreSQL and Redis are separate prerequisites. Container API port 3000 is mapped to a host port you choose. Configure your own application URL and secrets before starting.

ports.name: Backend API host port
ports.description: Required host port mapped to container API port 3000. Choose an unused port and set frontend BACKEND_PORT to the same number.

variables.name: Session secret
variables.description: Generate a unique secret with openssl rand -hex 32. Do not reuse an example secret.

variables.name: Application URL
variables.description: Full browser-facing URL, including HTTPS and any nonstandard port. Example: https://mail.example.com. Must match Frontend origin.

variables.name: Frontend origin
variables.description: Set to the same browser-facing origin as APP_URL, including scheme and port, without a trailing slash.

variables.name: PostgreSQL host
variables.description: Reachable database hostname or IPv4 address. For a database published on Unraid, use the Unraid host address, not localhost or a container name.

variables.name: PostgreSQL port
variables.description: Database port reachable at DB_HOST. For a database container published on Unraid, use its mapped host port.

variables.name: Database name
variables.description: Create this dedicated database before starting MailFlow.

variables.name: Database user
variables.description: Existing database role owning the MailFlow database and allowed to create/migrate its tables.

variables.name: Database password
variables.description: Password for the configured PostgreSQL role. No password is supplied by this template.

variables.name: Redis connection URL
variables.description: Redis connection URL using a reachable server address and port. For Redis on Unraid, use the host address and mapped Redis port. Include URL-encoded credentials if authentication is enabled.

variables.name: Credential encryption key
variables.description: Generate with openssl rand -hex 32 (64 hexadecimal characters). Back up securely; changing or losing it makes stored credentials unreadable.

variables.name: Internal API port
variables.description: Keep at 3000 to match the container port mapping. Choose the external port in Backend API host port.

variables.name: Google OAuth client ID
variables.description: Optional Google OAuth application client ID. Configure all Google OAuth fields together.

variables.name: Google OAuth redirect URI
variables.description: Optional exact registered callback URL: your application origin followed by /oauth/google/callback.

variables.name: Web push public key
variables.description: Optional. Generate a matching public/private pair with npx web-push generate-vapid-keys.

variables.name: Web push private key
variables.description: Optional private key matching VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY. Keep private and persistent.

variables.name: Web push contact
variables.description: Optional. Set with both VAPID keys: your mailto contact address or application URL.

variables.name: Trusted proxy hops
variables.description: Leave blank for default behavior. Use 2 only when all frontend access is restricted to your additional trusted reverse proxy; consult upstream guidance.
